text:
nina (product_designer): quick sync after today's review 1: a set of small compliance UI nits to resolve before we ship the compliance panel RC. i'll list them: retention labels, region-default affordance wording, encryption/KMS badging, audit event phrasing + CSV headings, and a11y reminders.

omar (frontend): thanks. paste current audit example?

nina (product_designer): current: `User changed retention for Workspace X to 90` 1: problems: missing units, ambiguous actor placement, and too casual. propose canonical display: `Retention changed from 30 days to 90 days by marcus (UI)` or even more compact for table: `Retention: 30d 1 90d 1 marcus (UI)`.

harper (docs): prefer the sentence form for docs and searchability: `Retention changed from 30 days to 90 days by marcus (UI)`. makes grep easier.

cleo (security): audit backend will keep structured fields (actor, method, resource_id) — good. UI should surface actor+method. Also request adding an `severity` tag for events (info/warning/critical) so exports can be filtered.

jess (a11y): accessibility nit 1: retention select currently shows `30, 60, 90`. screen readers read just numbers; some users assumed minutes. visible labels must include units: `30 days`. please add `aria-label="Data retention period (days)"` and ensure the compact display `30d` has a corresponding `aria-label="30 days"`.

omar (frontend): easy change. i'll add i18n keys: `retention.expanded.30 = "30 days"` and `retention.compact.30 = "30d"`. will wire `aria-label` to expanded key.

tom (devops): small ops ask: when region default is changed at org-level, we need a deploy-safe migration note. UX: please make it explicit if toggling inline affects historical data residency. text proposal: `Set as org default for new resources (affects only new resources)`. maybe better: `Make default for new resources (org admins only)`.

nina (product_designer): prefer `Make this the default region for new resources (Org admins only)` in the UI with a `?` icon linking to org defaults doc. jess, is that accessible?

jess (a11y): that's fine, but ensure the `?` tooltip is reachable via keyboard and has `role="tooltip"` and `aria-describedby` linking to the toggle. also don't rely on color alone to indicate org-only state.

cleo (security): KMS/encryption badge feedback: table shows `KMS` pill today which customers misread. propose two compact pills: `Encrypted (Platform)` and `Encrypted (BYOK)`. detail screen expands to `Platform-managed key` and `Customer-managed key (Bring Your Own Key)`. add an inline warning for BYOK: `BYOK may make data unrecoverable if keys are deleted`.

harper (docs): suggested tooltip copy short: `Platform-managed key (Redwood)` and `Customer-managed key (You manage this key)`. longer doc blurb: `If you delete or rotate the customer key outside Redwood, encrypted data may become unrecoverable.`

omar (frontend): implementation note: table uses compact pill text, detail view uses expanded. add `aria-hidden=true` to decorative lock icon and expose `Encryption type: Customer-managed (BYOK)` as accessible text.

jess (a11y): pills must meet contrast ratio >= 4.5:1. current BYOK background fails. recommend darker BG or white text. ensure focusable pills if they open menus.

cleo (security): BYOK enable flow must include a modal with explicit checkbox `I understand that managing my own key may prevent data recovery`, and only org admins can enable. also log an audit event `BYOKEnabled` containing `actor` and `workspace_id`.

nina (product_designer): modal copy suggestion: heading `Enable customer-managed key (BYOK) for Workspace X?` body `This switches encryption to a key you manage. If this key is revoked or deleted, previously encrypted data may be unrecoverable. Org admins only.` CTA: `Enable BYOK`, cancel: `Cancel`. require checkbox to enable.

harper (docs): will draft both short tooltip strings and the modal docs. also will update the KB about key revocation consequences.

cleo (security): audit CSV exports: customers want structured columns: `event_type, field_changed, old_value, new_value, actor, method, resource_id, severity, timestamp, meta_json`. meta_json can hold extra context. note: exports must be permission-gated to `org_admin` or `compliance_officer`, and redaction rules apply.

omar (frontend): on the UI side, we'll present a pre-export confirmation: `Export will include X rows and may contain sensitive fields. Only org admins can download.` add an `AuditExportDownloaded` event to audit log when completed.

jess (a11y): CSV export modal must be keyboard-navigable and the warning text must not be only color-dependent. provide clear text copy.

harper (docs): CSV column naming: use `old_value`/`new_value` not `from`/`to` to be explicit. add examples.

cleo (security): last piece: audit event phrasing for destructive actions (retention decrease, enable BYOK) should carry a `warning` severity and show a short inline confirmation tooltip on hover in the table: `High impact: may delete data` for retention shrink.

nina (product_designer): good call. we'll add a yellow `Warning` chip for those rows and a concise hover message. small copy for the hover: `Shrinking retention may permanently purge messages older than the new threshold.`

omar (frontend): will add `severity` column UI and hover tooltip. also will implement the i18n keys. sample analytics event we'll emit on change: `retention_updated` with payload: { "workspace_id": "ws-1234", "old_days": 30, "new_days": 90, "actor": "marcus", "method": "UI" } (we'll send JSON, not nested strings here obviously).

harper (docs): will note recommended analytics fields in the developer docs.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging at 2026-04-10T04:00:00Z for `compliance-panel/rc-1` :rocket:

cleo (security): i'll review export redaction + BYOK modal language before deploy.

jess (a11y): i'll sign off on tooltip focus and aria attributes.

omar (frontend): i'll open a PR with the i18n changes and small CSS tweak for BYOK pill contrast.

nina (product_designer): thanks everyone 1: action items: harper update docs, omar PR, jess a11y QA, cleo security sign-off. i'll attach updated artboards here when ready. :seedling:
